subtitle: Import organization charts, verify each reporting relationship, and review the current approval path without granting authority.
importBody: The document is scanned and extracted through the governed ingestion pipeline. Every relationship remains a proposal until an endpoint confirms it and an independent Owner approves it.

currentBody: Only independently reviewed active edges can be used to find an approver.
